title: Cheap Syrup
subtitle: Hurry, friends! The raspberry party is about to begin!

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: "AHHHHH!!!"

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: What was that?! Did someone scream?!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: My God, Jason, we have to check it out! I know they like to fool around, but we are here now ...
Anne lowers her voice and looks into the depths of the shadow. She remembers the terrible story about the woods.

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Michael, stay here and take a rest. Shh, don't make any noise.

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: Ugh, ugh, alright. They will all be fine, uh?

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Hope so.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Blonney! Blonney!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Stop playing hide-and-seek! This is not funny!

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Wait, look over there.
A waist-height bush shakes suspiciously. It's lush enough for an adult to hide behind.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Blonney? No, Freddie? Are you there?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Not funny at all! Not cool! You two always like to spook people like this. I will not believe ...

items.speaker: Butcher
items.text: Haahh ...!

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Anne, stay back!
Anne, stay back!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Ahhh!
The sharp blade cuts through the bushes, and their noses instantly catch the grassy smell. They stumble backward and fall to the ground.

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: What the hell is that?!

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: F**k! The, the stories are all true, all true! How is that possible? It is not in compliance with the laws of … nature!
The smell of blood hits them. Anne looks up and sees her friends, who are lying behind the bushes and looking lifeless.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Oh, no! No no no! This is not happening! Oh, Lord!

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: No more crying, Anne! Stand up, run! I will look out for you, run!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: They ... both of them ... are dead! My God! Jason … the blood is all over the place.

Jason helps his trembling friend get back on her feet. His legs are shaking as well, but they have to keep on running, as they dare not look back.—that suspicious bush has been pushed aside, behind which lie their friends, apparently breathless.

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Don't think too much. Don't look back. Run! Speed up!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Jason, head down!

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Uggh ...

items.speaker: Butcher
items.text: Hah ...

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: No! Don't ... Heavens! Jason!
His blood spurts out like a shaken soda. Then, his body falls backward, headless.
The air smells fishy. Anne keeps retreating, one step after another.

items.speaker: Giant Critter
items.text: *roars*

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Damn it! It's catching up!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It's moving too fast. I've never seen a critter this big!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Not only the size, its strength and speed are also much enhanced from what we learned in the arcane creatures class! It took Ms. Tooth Fairy's velvet pocket. We have to bring it down before it's too late!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Horropedia, do you have some cobweb bullets to trap it?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Only one left. Are you sure we have to fight it in the woods? We don't have an edge.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: The campsite was completely destroyed within 15 seconds. I don't suggest that we kill ourselves in this way.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: According to the map, there is the other campsite built in a wider region. We can fight it there!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Turn left here, keep going for a hundred meters, and then cross the bush!

items.speaker: Giant Critter
items.text: Hisss!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Ohhh!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Shoot that bullet! It's going to get you!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: What a pity! I was thinking of catching something else!

items.speaker: Giant Critter
items.text: *roars*

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Excellent! It's trapped!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The bush is right over there. Follow me. Let's speed up!

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: Ugh ... Ahhh ...
Michael suffers a slow death. He lies between the bushes and moans in pain. Little by little, his blood drains away.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: No, no, no ...
While Anne is like a scream player. She screams the same line repeatedly, circling around the camp again and again.
But the butcher's blade always lands on the ground one inch behind her heel, not even touching one bit of her body.

items.speaker: Butcher
items.text: Heh ...

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Don't, don't get closer! No, don't! Wait, you people are ...
The figure jumping out of the bushes is coming straight at her. Anne closes her eyes in desperation.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ahhh!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: My apologies, I didn't mean to intrude ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: My God! What, what has happened here?!
Before coming out to the other side of the bush, none of them has ever expected such a horrific scene.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: A crazy murderer? Student campers? Oh, this is much more interesting than I expected.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Protect the victims. Get ready to fight!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Who are you?! And the bushes ... Why did you come out of the bushes?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Worry not, Miss. Please get behind. You're safe with us.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: No, no, no, that's my friend! And they aren't ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I understand. They deserve a decent funeral after I take care of this demonic creature.
Sonetto grasps her wand, keeping her friend behind.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: May the peace be with us.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Sonetto, calm down.

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: Oh, no! Don't bury me. I don't wanna die.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What?!

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: *spits* This taste of cherry syrup is killing me!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You ... you're still alive?

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: Ah? Of course. What kind of question is that!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But you were vomiting blood, and that gentleman over there doesn't even have a head attached to his body.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: That's the prop. It looks like a real one. Nicely done.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: You add bloody-taste substitute into the cherry syrup, which makes it smell like the real blood.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Be prudent about the dosage because it's slightly addictive ... *sniffs* You've used too much.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What on earth is happening?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: This is a theater or a filming site.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: These young people are busy with their business, while we just interrupted them.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: I'm Anne. Are you, too, the actors Jennifer recruited?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I'm afraid I don't know this Jennifer you are referring to.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Ah, my bad. She sometimes goes by the name Blonney. It was just me who always calls her Jennifer.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: F**king damn it! You idiots! Get your ass up. There's no way we can use this take!
The "bodies" covered in blood get back on their feet one after another. The girl with blonde hair and blood stains on her face rushes angrily over.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Here she comes! Sorry, excuse me.
Anne swings her arms and runs toward Blonney, like a fluttering little bird.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You! Who are you?!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Vertin.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ah, no, no! That's not what I'm asking!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Huh? Are you asking me? I am Horropedia.
Horropedia's eyes light up, looking at each one of the people standing before him.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: And you are ... the big one, the athlete; the smaller one, the fool; and the slim one, the scholar.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: The only girl who's standing here ...

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: It seems like the first girl who lay down, I'm talking about you, a ... ahem, alright, a Blondie.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: What the hell? What is in your shrinked brain?!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I'm asking who the hell you are, why you are here, and what do you break into my film site for?!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Film?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Yes, we were in the middle of shooting a movie, a horror movie.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Jennifer is our dire- ... director? And playwright ... is that the word?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Horror movie? Here?
He blinks. His face is suddenly lit by an unusual glow.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Where is your gear? What's the story?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: What's your business here?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: What? Or, aren't you confident enough?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: The gear is right here! And the script too! Take a good look at it, smart-ass!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Recorder CCD-TR57? The latest version, a pretty one. It costs quite a lot and has many features.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Optical camouflage outer shell, long stand-by time for operating independently, and hand-gesture-triggered flashlights and lighting adjustments … Wow!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: It's the first time to see a real one other than those advertisements printed on magazines. Hah, what a coincidence! How do you use the flash?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Hey! Wait! Take your hands off me!
She is not quick enough to avoid Horropedia, who pinches the edge of her sleeve and drags her arms, moving up and down.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: With a snap? A wave? Or adjusting your glasses?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Or an applause?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Let go of me!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Ahahahaha, it's the applause! Now it's easier!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Unbelievable! What the hell do you think you are doing?! Piss off!

items.speaker: Giant Critter
items.text: *roars*

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: … 5 minutes, 31 seconds. The sticky bullet should have been four times more powerful than this, but still within my estimation.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Hey, Blondie, clap your hands!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: God! Damn it! For freak's sake! Look what you brought here!
The blonde girl shakily claps her hands.

items.speaker: Giant Critter
items.text: *roars*
The autofocus Recorder rises into the air, generating a strong light as Blonney claps her hands.
The critter roars in pain, waving its huge claws wildly. The Recorder is hit and explodes into pieces.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: My camera!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Good. Now it's time!
